summary_1line: Krishna, Bhishma, and Drona urge Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas, warning that Arjuna is unbeatable and war will destroy the Kuru race.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands in the royal court addressing Duryodhana while assembled elders listen as he warns of Arjuna’s invincibility and urges peace.
Bhishma, the aged warrior with white beard and armor, rises in the Kuru court and solemnly warns Duryodhana not to destroy his own race.
An imagined vision of Arjuna on the battlefield, bow drawn and blazing with fury, as terrified warriors hesitate to face him.
